Messages.Author: evilp...@my-deja.com
Messages.Body:
In a game last weekend, Rigby attempted to block my predator's attempt
to equip Ian Wallingford(bishop) with a Writ of Acceptance, and failed
to generate intercept. Ian was the only bishop controlled by my
predator, and had 2 blood.

So. Does Rigby move a blood to Ian, or does the Writ action succeed
first? The table decided Rigby should move a blood, as the block
attempt fails before the action is successful (other minions, including
those of the acting minion's predator, could block, etc...). Was this
the correct analysis?

:D

Mike P.

Sent via Deja.com
http://www.deja.com/

Messages.Body:

Yes.

based on that card he now played na intercept?)?
